<<code language="ocaml" | sig
  type get = Get_method
  type put = Put_method
  type post = Post_method
  type delete = Delete_method
  type co = Co
  type non_co = Non_co
  type ext = Ext
  type non_ext = Non_ext
  type http = Http_ret
  type 'a ocaml = Ocaml of 'a
  type non_ocaml = Non_ocaml
  type reg = Reg
  type non_reg = Non_reg
  type ('get, 'a, 'gn) params = ('get, 'a, 'gn) Parameter.params_type
    constraint 'a = [< `WithSuffix | `WithoutSuffix ]
  type ('m, _, _, _, _, _, _) meth =
      Get :
        ('gp, 'a, 'gn) Service_sigs.TYPES.params -> (Service_sigs.TYPES.get,
                                                     'gp, 'gn, unit, 
                                                     unit,
                                                     [< `WithSuffix
                                                      | `WithoutSuffix ]
                                                     as 'a, unit)
                                                    Service_sigs.TYPES.meth
    | Post : ('gp, 'b, 'gn) Service_sigs.TYPES.params *
        ('pp, [ `WithoutSuffix ], 'pn) Service_sigs.TYPES.params -> (Service_sigs.TYPES.post,
                                                                    'gp, 'gn,
                                                                    'pp, 'pn,
                                                                    [< 
                                                                    `WithSuffix
                                                                  | `WithoutSuffix
                                                                    ] as 'b,
                                                                    'gp)
                                                                    Service_sigs.TYPES.meth
    | Put :
        ('gp, 'c, 'gn) Service_sigs.TYPES.params -> (Service_sigs.TYPES.put,
                                                     'gp, 'gn,
                                                     Parameter.raw_post_data,
                                                     Parameter.no_param_name,
                                                     [< `WithSuffix
                                                      | `WithoutSuffix ]
                                                     as 'c, unit)
                                                    Service_sigs.TYPES.meth
    | Delete :
        ('gp, 'd, 'gn) Service_sigs.TYPES.params -> (Service_sigs.TYPES.delete,
                                                     'gp, 'gn,
                                                     Parameter.raw_post_data,
                                                     Parameter.no_param_name,
                                                     [< `WithSuffix
                                                      | `WithoutSuffix ]
                                                     as 'd, unit)
                                                    Service_sigs.TYPES.meth
  type 'm which_meth =
      Get' : Service_sigs.TYPES.get Service_sigs.TYPES.which_meth
    | Post' : Service_sigs.TYPES.post Service_sigs.TYPES.which_meth
    | Put' : Service_sigs.TYPES.put Service_sigs.TYPES.which_meth
    | Delete' : Service_sigs.TYPES.delete Service_sigs.TYPES.which_meth
end >>
